name: valid operator yaml merges core presets, resolves placeholders, normalizes urls, sorts descriptors, and excludes tokens
operatorYaml:
agentyard:
  extensions:
    services:
      - registrationId: acme-business-connectors
        baseUrl: ${ACME_CONNECTOR_URL}
        exposes:
          toolConnectorTypes:
            - enterprise.acme.erp
            - enterprise.acme.crm
            - enterprise.acme.crm
        auth:
          type: INTERNAL_TOKEN
      - registrationId: acme-channel-provider
        baseUrl: HTTP://Channel.Example.com:80/agentyard/
        exposes:
          channelProviderTypes:
            - enterprise.acme.ticket
            - enterprise.acme.internal-im
        auth:
          type: INTERNAL_TOKEN
variantOperatorYaml:
agentyard:
  extensions:
    services:
      - registrationId: acme-channel-provider
        baseUrl: http://channel.example.com/agentyard
        exposes:
          channelProviderTypes:
            - enterprise.acme.internal-im
            - enterprise.acme.ticket
        auth:
          type: INTERNAL_TOKEN
      - registrationId: acme-business-connectors
        baseUrl: https://tools.example.com/extensions
        exposes:
          toolConnectorTypes:
            - enterprise.acme.crm
            - enterprise.acme.erp
        auth:
          type: INTERNAL_TOKEN
